crossRefs.note: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh…
Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I…
For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t…
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
translations.bsb: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
translations.kjv: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken
translations.asv: And Moses said before Jehovah, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
